Tidyups Cleaning assured Richard that his cleaners do not try to extend their time unnecessarily and are honest about their work. Richard mentioned he used to work with cleaners frequently in leasing and is interested in establishing an ongoing cleaning arrangement. Richard requested a quote for cleaning services four times a month and two times a month for the same property.
